digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow and test harness for rebar repository
propositions: Ubuntu Verified jobs occupy 30.2 runner-minutes per run due to redundant YAML parsing (bridge cadence test loads workflow 1,440 times) and repeated Pandoc subprocess invocations without reducing behavioral coverage

Gerrit Verified run completion times exceed 30 minutes due to distributed macOS execution and orchestration overhead; pre-merge superseded jobs were not canceled (always() predicates prevented GitHub cancellation) causing 25+ minute admission delays

Static immutable Pandoc legacy oracle (883 deduplicated subprocesses in hardening suite) can replace live subprocess re-execution while retaining full real-Pandoc conversions for all 884 corpus units and moving complete replay to External Integration scheduled workflow

AST provenance fixture repeatedly rediscovers enclosing callers and parent relationships (130.9M calls over 48s setup) without requiring per-test recomputation; single-process build of caller/parent indices preserves all 24 tuples and guards
Static repository policy as singleton outside language matrix cells eliminates 19-node re-evaluation per matrix permutation while preserving all gates and complexity proofs
Organic post-remediation runs validate 20–30 minute completion-time target and 21.1% baseline Ubuntu occupancy reduction without adding parallel jobs, extra runners, or removing coverage assertions
